result.reason: The added 30-day non-renewal deadline satisfies the notice-window component and preserves the existing termination and breach provisions. However, the clause does not reach the preferred position because it omits the required 60-day Vendor renewal reminder and the CPI/3% price-increase cap. It also fails the fallback because it contains no 5% cap on renewal price increases. The overlapping 30-day non-renewal and 90-day post-Initial-Term termination provisions are workable but could be clarified.
